subject: Marine Works - Dredging and Pile Driving - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Dredging and Pile Driving - Fraser River
Dredging and pile driving operations will take place in Cannery Channel at 49 07.052N 123 09.765W.
Hours of operation are from 1330 to 0000 UTC daily.
Vancouver Pile Driving will be on site monitoring VHF channel 18A.
Minimum wake.
